description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'SkillServiceTest' aimed at testing the 'SkillService' component within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It includes setup, mock dependencies, and test methods for CRUD operations and search functionality related to the Skill entity.

classes.name: SkillServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the SkillService, including delete, retrieve, save, and search operations within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up SkillService instance, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests the deletion of skills via SkillService with mocked SkillDao.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a skill by ID via SkillService with mocked SkillDao.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new skill via SkillService with mocked SkillDao.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills via SkillService with mocked SkillDao and predefined search parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests retrieving count of skills matching search parameters via SkillService with mocked SkillDao.
